node.label: Horizontal supranuclear gaze palsy
node.definition: A supranuclear gaze palsy is an inability to look in a horizontal direction as a result of cerebral impairment. There is a loss of the voluntary aspect of eye movements, but, as the brainstem is still intact, all the reflex conjugate eye movements are normal.

evidence.snippet: Gaucher disease, type III: Horizontal supranuclear gaze palsy [IEA]
